whenToUse: You show where the result of an action elsewhere landed.
Icons whose number went up, such as a cart or notifications.
Services with a light, playful mood.
whenNotToUse: Errors or warnings (use a shake or a message).
The reaction of the pressed button itself (use a micro-interaction).

alternatives.name: Spring
alternatives.reason: Movement that overshoots the target and comes back.

alternatives.name: Badge
alternatives.reason: When the number changing is enough.

accessibility: The new count is announced with role=status, so people who miss the motion still know.
With reduced motion, it doesn't bounce.
It plays once and never repeats on its own.
The bounce height is kept small at 14px.
